plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/SKILL..why: Carries four rules from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude in T3 wording: load a managed platform's skill before deploying, stop an abandoned agent whose writes could overlap its replacement's with task_cancel and confirm with task_status that it stopped, which Autopilot-full's immediate replacement of a stuck agent overrides, keep a review gate closed while no independent reviewer can run, and keep the todolist in .audit/<task-slug>.todo.md when the session has no task tool.

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/playbo.why: Points step 4 at the Subagents rule that every file-writing delegate gets its own worktree from HEAD, and carries the rule from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude that the delegator commits what the delegate builds on, names that commit in the brief, and never writes or runs a suite in a worktree a delegate still holds.

Carries the rule from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude that every live agent holding a worktree is stopped, and the stop confirmed, before a commit, merge, or deploy from it, and drops the reset --hard between delegates on one branch so that each gets its own worktree.

Adds --match-head-commit <head> to the GitHub merge in step 4, the head guard from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude, with the current head whose verdict survives step 3's patch-id rule, so a head pushed after that check cannot land, and stops step 5's watcher loop at a merge gate that needs a person.

plugins/pstack/skills/poteto-mode/script.why: Expects the --settle default that cli.ts adds.
Adds the --settle option (default 300 seconds, 0 disables) that the T3 settle overlay in settle.ts reads.
Gives the fake reader the reviewActivity method the settle overlay adds to GitHubReader.

Gives the gh reader the reviewActivity method that settle.ts uses, and carries two fixes from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude: a completed check that gh buckets as pending, such as STALE, reads as failed instead of pending forever (pstack-claude #97), and a head with no checks configured reads as such when gh reports none and the head has no rollup (pstack-claude #153).
Sets settle: 0 on the shared PollingOptions, so the upstream tests run with the settle overlay off.

Holds READY while settle.ts reports the PR settling, and carries two fixes from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude: a required review or another branch protection rule that blocks the frontier PR with clean CI stops at a merge gate instead of reading as READY (pstack-claude #95), and a PR with no checks configured gets a verdict instead of retrying forever, once GitHub has computed mergeability, no commit on it has reported checks, and a BLOCKED read of the same head has held for 60 seconds (pstack-claude #153, #223).

Prints the settle column and the review-settling lines from settle.ts, and the review-required, branch-protection, and no-checks states that the fixes from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude add, with a merge-gate action that says a person is needed.

Adds the settle state, decision, and reader method that settle.ts defines, and the review-required and merge-blocked gates and the no-checks read and CI state that the fixes from Michael Denyer's pstack-claude add.

plugins/pstack/skills/setup-pstack/SKILL.why: Writes the T3 model sheet from orchestrator_capabilities targets and checks it with t3-sheet.mjs, in place of Cursor's always-applied .mdc rule built from model slugs.
